final_topology.title: Government Cloud Segmentation
final_topology.description: Secure cloud infrastructure for government agency with departmental segmentation and centralized monitoring.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology will include a central hub for management and monitoring, with separate spokes for each department, ensuring secure and isolated environments.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n_new1) that manages inventory for all nodes, indicating a detailed and maintained asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n_new2) that documents data flows for all nodes, indicating documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Production Zone' (z6) and 'Non-Production Zone' (z7), indicating segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n1) and an 'Application Firewall' (n12), indicating firewalls are implemented and managed.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n10) that provides DNS services to various nodes, indicating trusted DNS server configuration.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Service' (n8) that provides MFA for various nodes, indicating MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n11) that performs URL filtering, indicating DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n11) that performs URL filtering, indicating network-based URL filters are enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones with defined roles and peering relationships, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n1), 'SIEM System' (n5), and 'Bastion Host' (n6), indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n2) and 'MFA Service' (n8), indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Bastion Host' (n6) and 'MFA Service' (n8), indicating remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n13) that monitors network traffic, indicating a deployed network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes peering links between zones with labels indicating traffic filtering, such as 'production_segmentation' and 'non_production_segmentation'.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Network Access Control' (NAC) (n14) and 'MFA Service' (n8), indicating access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n13) that collects network traffic flow logs, indicating collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Production Zone' (z6) and 'Non-Production Zone' (z7), indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'External Penetration Testing Zone' (z8) and a 'Penetration Testing Service' (n_new3), indicating periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z6 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z7 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes to indicate inventory management.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology shows data flows between nodes, but there is no explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant nodes to indicate data flow documentation.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an External Penetration Testing Zone (z8) and a Penetration Testing Workstation (n16), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests being performed.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests being performed is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to relevant nodes to indicate the performance of periodic external penetration tests.
